subject: general
question: From the numbers 583, 459, 687, 754 and 853, which of the following will be the lowest number, if in each number, all the 8s and 5s are replaced with 2 and 1, respectively?
solution:
When all the 8s and 5s are replaced with 2 and 1, respectively, we get:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1c918dbfe8f01e6ea64d1ceaf22a2d2339709aa2d0da81a26655a4717673166.png] 

We can see that the lowest number is **123** which was originally **583.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"583".**
